EVAL-F-001-S1.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-001-S1.description: Define request/response schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, and optional travel enrichment flags; response must include structured trial fields (NCT ID, title, status, locations), eligibility summary, and normalized location objects. Align with Pydantic models and downstream facade contract.

EVAL-F-001-S2.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
EVAL-F-001-S2.description: Implement core search logic calling ClinicalTrials.gov API with RECRUITING filter, condition and location parameters; parse and normalize response into internal schema, extract trial locations, and handle empty/partial results.

EVAL-F-001-S3.title: Add Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
EVAL-F-001-S3.description: Augment trial location results with optional travel distance and duration using Google Routes API; compute from user location to trial sites and append to response while preserving base results if enrichment fails.

EVAL-F-001-S4.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-001-S4.description: Expose clinical trials search through evaluate_care_facade with validated inputs, tool routing compatibility, and structured response delivery to the chat layer.

EVAL-F-001-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
EVAL-F-001-S5.description: Create unit tests for schema validation and search parsing, plus integration tests covering end-to-end flow from facade to service including travel enrichment and error handling.
